youtube.title: OKX 24/7 Stock Tokens: Six Stocks After the Bell | OKX News
youtube.description:
OKX opened round-the-clock trading in six stock tokens on November 23, letting eligible US customers use USDC in the OKX app after the stock market closes.

What happened:
• Six stock tokens launched, including Robinhood, Circle and Strategy
• Underlying shares back the tokens one-for-one, the venue says
• OKX says 113 assets are confirmed for a rolling rollout
• The venue is a joint venture with affiliates of ICE, parent company of the NYSE

Why it matters: stock tokens can trade outside market hours, but their price can differ from the underlying share, so check the quote first.

Source: CryptoSlate, Nov 25, 2026

FAQ
Who can use OKX stock tokens?
Eligible US customers who meet location rules, verify identity and complete onboarding.
Do stock tokens trade at the same price as the stock?
Not always. Outside regular hours, prices can differ from the underlying share.
